findings.namedBuyers: Verified commercially relevant organizer leaders: Souad Dous, SPHERE Co-founder and Partner, directly promoting PODIUM 2027; Jérôme Sicard, SPHERE Co-founder and Publisher. Both are relationship/referral candidates, not proven hotel-contract buyers. Dominik Buholzer, finews CEO and Editor-in-Chief, authored the 2027 announcement and is a secondary co-organizer referral. Rebeca Valença hosted PODIUM 2025 interviews; her present operational role is not established. Public shared event contact: events@sphere.swiss. See contact candidates for role evidence and limitations.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming third edition on Tuesday 2 March 2027, Geneva, within the requested horizon. The official activity schedule runs 08:30 welcome coffee to 18:30 closing cocktail, so start and end date are both 2027-03-02. Predominantly French. The 10 November 2026 finews announcement independently confirms the event date; that publication date is not the activity date. No 2028 edition announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief and verified event format: weak fit for the main event because it is committed to central Geneva, while YOTEL Geneva Lake is in Founex. Six partner salons, seven CIO panels, lunch and cocktail are published, but attendance, simultaneous room needs and catering covers are not; the hotel’s six rooms and approximately 250-theatre maximum do not establish whole-event suitability. Resort/retreat positioning is not evidenced. Only a separately qualified organizer/speaker/sponsor stay or ancillary meeting is a plausible conditional role; no actual such lodging demand is published. Do not forecast a 20–120-room block, full-house use or banquet capacity.
findings.venueCommitments: The official 2027 page explicitly names Hôtel Métropole, Quai du Général-Guisan 34, 1204 Genève, Switzerland. Territory: Geneva city, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte or the airport corridor. Quote: “Genève · Mardi 2 mars 2027 · Hôtel Métropole”. This is a published event-venue commitment at a competing hotel, not evidence of a signed contract, exclusivity or bedroom allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: Geneva editions are documented at Hôtel Métropole on 13 May 2025 and 12 March 2026, followed by the announced 2 March 2027 edition at the same hotel. This supports recurrence and Geneva venue retention, not destination rotation or a fixed annual March date. Zurich is a separate companion city event, not evidence that the Geneva edition rotates: 15 May 2025 Baur au Lac; 9 March 2026 Mandarin Oriental Savoy Zurich; 4 March 2027 Baur au Lac. No 2028 dates or venue were found.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. The 2027 event page names only Hôtel Métropole as the Geneva event venue and publishes no accommodation booking link, housing bureau, room-block hotels, rates, room nights or open hotel RFP. Quote: “Toute inscription est soumise à validation par les organisateurs : vous recevrez une confirmation par e-mail.” This describes event admission, not lodging procurement. The published event enquiry route is events@sphere.swiss. No edition-specific lodging commitment at Métropole or another hotel was located; do not infer independently booked/open lodging from this silence. Baur au Lac is the separate Zurich venue, not a Geneva room-block hotel.
findings.organizationStructure: PODIUM is described officially as the joint flagship investment event of SPHERE and finews. SPHERE is a Swiss financial media, events and training platform, not presented as a membership association; finews is the media co-organizer. Commercial classification: media-led professional investment event. No external PCO, DMC, housing agency or separately appointed accommodation buyer was identified. Venue operator Hôtel Métropole must not be conflated with the event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Métropole is the incumbent Geneva event hotel across three documented/announced editions. Its official location page calls the location central, supporting a geographic advantage over Founex for this programme. No sold-out notice, displacement, overflow request, accommodation shortfall or competitor bedroom block was found. Repeated venue use is not evidence of bedroom exclusivity, and historical use is not open inventory.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a short qualification enquiry to events@sphere.swiss, addressed to Souad Dous and requesting the operational accommodation/venue lead; Jérôme Sicard is the second leadership route. Acknowledge the 2 March 2027 Métropole commitment. Ask whether any organizer/speaker/partner nights are needed, who books and pays, whether a central room agreement exists, required dates/counts, and whether Founex is acceptable. Offer an ancillary stay or small meeting only after demand and transport acceptance are confirmed; do not issue a speculative room block. Separately ask about the next venue-review cycle and permission to introduce YOTEL for suitable future smaller formats. Leave qualification and publication gates to ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, primary venue capture is not an evidenced sales path: Hôtel Métropole is already publicly selected. Attendance is subject to organizer approval and restricted to eligible investment professionals; hotel sales should approach the organizer rather than assume delegate access. Accommodation accessibility remains unconfirmed, not closed and not open. The 08:30–18:30 one-day format does not itself establish overnight stays. No event-specific Geneva Airport routing or lodging toward La Côte was located.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship development is more defensible than an immediate room-block bid. Recurrence is evidenced by 2025–2027, but no published 2028 edition, venue tender, sourcing deadline or move away from Métropole was found. Explore a distinct SPHERE workshop or partner meeting in the La Côte/airport corridor only if the organizer identifies a real requirement. Do not present hypothetical 2028 capture as confirmed demand.
